tiers.name: ULTRA MEGA
tiers.note: body HP ×15.84, then the night's ×0.25 (yetis) · ×0.5 (snowmen, pigs); the three bosses' bars flat for any party since v29.45 (Sergeant Cold 9,000 · Sergeant Snowman 10,000 · King Yeti 17,000); the home turret and the new guns are off on this tier (the heavies standing the rolling ball and the snowball tripping mines too): the old guns, one KO a bolt every 2.2 s

damageLaw: In the Ice Castle almost every enemy hit is a KO, whatever a man's HP: the yetis' pounce, Sergeant Cold's big snowball and sprint, Sergeant Snowman's rolling ball on a light man, and every move King Yeti has (snowball, sword, seize, blue wind, leap). Only three hits take part of a man, and since v29.17 the damper lands each of them on your men at 50 %: the snowman's thrown ball (2 bar hits, MEGA and ULTRA MEGA ×1.2, at the damper 1 · 1.2, landing 90 % + 10 % × bar ÷ HP of that), THEIR turret on EASY to MEGA (0.625 · 0.75 · 0.875 · 1.2 HP a round off his sheet HP, a fifth on a heavy; ULTRA MEGA a KO a bolt) and Sergeant Snowman's ball on a heavy (25 % of his bar, MEGA 30 %; ULTRA MEGA a KO). Difficulty changes the bodies, the head-counts and the clocks; a KO hit is a KO on every tier, and the damper never touches it.
headlines: Almost every enemy hit is a KO whatever a man's HP: the munchkin's and the big yeti's pounce, Sergeant Cold's big snowball, sprint and (MEGA / ULTRA MEGA) purple leap, Sergeant Snowman's rolling ball on a light man, King Yeti's snowball, sword (2 men a swing), red seize (after 0.9 s held), blue wind (every man within 280 px) and (ULTRA MEGA) purple leap, and THEIR turret on ULTRA MEGA.

Three hits take part of a man, each landing at 50 % under the damper since v29.17 (50 % off every bar hit and HP hit on your men; a KO is not a hit): the snowman's thrown ball (2 bar hits, MEGA / ULTRA MEGA ×1.2, landing as 1 · 1.2; 20 % / 40 % slower fire a ball up to 90 %, the M. gunner ×1.2); THEIR turret on EASY to MEGA (0.625 · 0.75 · 0.875 · 1.2 HP a round as it lands on E · M · H · G, a heavy a fifth: a level-25 rifleman falls in 3.6 s, a flame in 75 s on EASY); Sergeant Snowman's ball on a heavy (25 % of his bar, MEGA 30 %: 4 volleys in a row KO him).

The saber Sarge turns a KO 50 % of the time at rank 25 (measured 15–21 of 40 pounces a tier on Chrome, 17–24 on WebKit) and some turret rounds. The hero kings (King Yeti, King Rex) bounce thrown and rolling snowballs; the pounce KOs every hero; King Croak was never touched by a snowman's ball in 5 s (measured, not a law).
The mine: Sergeant Snowman's rolling ball trips your charge on EASY to MEGA, the ball bursts and a rifleman 65 px off is KO'd by the full blast (v28.81); ULTRA MEGA rolls over it.

Difficulty changes the bodies (×1 · ×1.5 · ×2.2 · ×2.64 · ×15.84, ULTRA MEGA then the night's ×0.25 yetis · ×0.5 snowmen, pigs and sergeants · ×0.6048 the king), the head-counts (166 · 190 · 246 · 246 · 161 bodies solo, the three bosses not counted) and the clocks (King Yeti's snowball every 2.6 · 2.08 · 1.35 · 1.35 · 1.35 s); a KO hit is a KO on every tier.

changes.title: ULTRA MEGA HP: THE NIGHT KINGS' BARS FLAT FOR ANY PARTY
changes.what: ULTRA MEGA: the three bosses' bars no longer grow with the commanders in the fight: Sergeant Cold 9,000, Sergeant Snowman 10,000, King Yeti 17,000 with one commander and with ten (the +3,000 with 3 commanders went with it). Sergeant Snowman hops toward your men there (the first 12 s after he steps on, then every 24 s; the landing is a KO for the men within 48 px; not in this proof). EASY to MEGA keep the party law.

changes.title: READ AGAIN ON v29.45
changes.what: Read again on v29.45 after the day's cards: the three bosses' bars for one commander on EASY · MEDIUM · HARD follow the designers' time-to-kill chart (CARD-RXT, v29.37: King Yeti 2,029 · 2,705 · 4,058, the sergeants in step) and on MEGA the player-damage-threshold pass's number (CARD-PDT: King Yeti 4,860); the men's tenth-rank HP moved (CARD-FLT, v29.40: the flame's rungs through level 50 tripled; CARD-DHP, v29.41: the bazooka's and commando's doubled): at level 25 the flame 55 HP, the bazooka 33, the commando 41. WHO SURVIVES and THE LEVEL A MAN FIRST SURVIVES count it.

changes.title: THE DAMPER
changes.what: Every enemy blow on your men lands at 50 % in the campaign and the boss fights: 50 % off every bar hit and HP hit, one row in THE BOSS LAB's RULES (THE DAMPER, a cell a tier). In the castle three hits take part of a man and all three land at 50 %: the snowman's ball (a level-25 rifleman takes 0.94 of his 6 bar hits on EASY, was 1.89), THEIR turret's round (0.625 HP on EASY, was 1.25: a lone level-25 rifleman now falls in 3.6 s, a flame in 75.5 s, measured) and Sergeant Snowman's ball on a heavy (25 % of his bar, was 50 %: 4 volleys in a row KO him). A KO is not a hit: every KO strike in this fight lands as before.

changes.title: KING YETI'S TURRETS
changes.what: EASY to MEGA: the home post on the road by your toy box starts neutral like the two in the middle (it started OURS); a side that holds its ring alone 3 s takes it. A boss alone in a ring now takes a post like any yeti (the ring skipped every boss). The castle's posts lost their flag pole.

changes.title: KING YETI'S FIELD
changes.what: EASY to MEGA: a third turret, OURS from the whistle, on the road by your toy box. Both sides' guns fire a 3-round burst every 0.5 s. THEIR gun stops being a KO: a round takes 1.25 · 1.5 · 1.75 · 2 HP (E · M · H · G, MEGA ×1.2 on top), a fifth of that on the bazooka, grenadier, flame and commando. OUR gun does half to the big yeti, the sergeants and the king. Sergeant Snowman's ball takes half a heavy's bar instead of a KO. A rolling snowball sets off your charges. ULTRA MEGA is not in it.

changes.title: ROUND 2 · THE FULL BLAST
changes.what: A charge a snowball sets off blasts your own men too, the campaign's own friendly fire (Wyatt: "Full blast with friendly fire"). Measured: a rifleman 65 px from the charge was KO'd on every tier.

changes.title: THE HEAVIES
changes.what: +3 HP every tenth rank for the bazooka, grenadier, flame and commando. At level 25: bazooka 33, grenadier 22, flame 55, commando 41 HP. THEIR turret reads this HP; the KO strikes do not care.

changes.title: THE BOMBER
changes.what: Your bomber flies in every boss fight now, the castle included, and aims at the thickest knot of yetis (or the boss).

changes.title: ONE HP NUMBER
changes.what: Your man's HP is the number on his unit sheet. A snowman's ball still counts in bar hits, but lands a little lighter on tough men: 90 % + 10 % × bar ÷ HP (a level-25 flame takes 1.82 of 2, a rifleman 1.89; before the damper).

changes.title: THE BOSS LAB'S STOCK ARMY
changes.what: The lab fights King Yeti with its own army at LEVEL 25 (the lab's stock level): the one this breakdown reads.

changes.title: HIS FORCE POWERS (a read, no change)
changes.what: King Yeti's seize and blue wind are ON at every tier. The fight hides them (half his seizes find nobody within 300 px, his snowball often KOs the man he holds, his sword swings at air between 64 and 130 px). Its fixes wait on Wyatt's KYP-Q1..Q4.

changes.title: UNCHANGED SINCE THEN
changes.what: As read in v29.45: the yetis' pounce, every KO strike of both sergeants and of King Yeti, the units' bodies, the wave sheets and head-counts (the bosses' bars moved: the rows above).

rows.t: A proposal (Nov 1, 2026, re-read Nov 2, 2026 with THE DAMPER), nothing in the game has changed. Since v29.17 THE DAMPER lets 50 % of every enemy hit land on your men; a KO is not dampened today, a numbered hit would be, so the number written in the game is the proposed hit over that share (or the strike is set to land in full). The game fells a man whose HP reaches 0, so a hit equal to his HP fells him and one under it leaves him standing; the three heavies are Wyatt's list; HP is each man's at the lab's level for the tier, as the page read it. A man a strike never fells today, or fells by bar hits (a Sarge with a blade up, the riot shield, the snowball bouncers), keeps that rule.

questions.text: THE KO PASS: the strikes that KO today would hit for EASY 32 · MEDIUM 32 · HARD 32 · MEGA 32 · ULTRA MEGA 32 HP by tier (the lab's level 25 · 25 · 25 · 25 · 25), the top of the window EASY 25 to 32 · MEDIUM 25 to 32 · HARD 25 to 32 · MEGA 25 to 32 · ULTRA MEGA 25 to 32: the hardest hit that leaves every heavy standing, with the weakest (the BAZOOKA everywhere) at 1 HP. The bottom of the window leaves him 2 to 7 HP and lets no lesser man stand either.
questions.rec: the top, as Wyatt framed it (high, not enough to defeat a heavy); say the bottom if the BAZOOKA should keep a cushion.

questions.text: At the proposed hit the lab's Sarge EASY SABER 25: falls · MEDIUM SABER 25: falls · HARD SABER 25: falls · MEGA SABER 25: falls · ULTRA MEGA SABER 25: falls (as today, where the strike takes him), and every hero stands: on EASY the PRINCESS CROAK falls in 2 hits and the KING CROAK in 6 (today most of these strikes fell a hero in one). Count the Sarge as a heavy and the number drops under his HP, and the M. GUNNER stands with him.
questions.rec: as proposed: the Sarge keeps his saves (the shield, the blade, the Claymore), and a hero who shrugs off a KO strike is what his bar is for; say so if a hero should still fall in one.

questions.text: The number is pinned to the lab's level for the tier: a player who comes in higher has men with 4 to 5 more HP a decade (the heavies 9 to 10), so his lesser men start standing (the M. GUNNER first) while his heavies stand wider.
questions.rec: as is; a card that moves a lab level re-runs this pass with the five kits (one command).

questions.text: THE DAMPER (since v29.17) lets 50 % of every enemy hit land on your men; a KO is not dampened today, a numbered hit would be. On EASY the proposed 32 is written in the game at 64 to land 32, or at 32 set to land in full. Written over the damper, the number moves when the damper moves: with 30 % off (the damper's first take) the 64 would land 44.8 on the BAZOOKA (33 HP) and fell him.
questions.rec: set the numbered strikes to land in full, so each number holds whatever the damper is set to; say so if they should ride the damper like every other hit.
